svg.title: Heart Disease Prediction Pipeline
svg.desc: End-to-end ML pipeline flowchart with correct dataset size of 1000 records.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me about the Indian Cardiovascular Disease dataset used in this project')
sendPrompt('What statistical tests were used to understand the study population?')
sendPrompt('How is data preprocessed in the codebase?')
sendPrompt('What train/test split ratio is used and how are the subsets stratified?')
sendPrompt('Which ML models are trained in the codebase and what are their hyperparameters?')
sendPrompt('How are models evaluated? What metrics does the app show in the Performance tab?')
sendPrompt('How does the best model get selected from the five trained models?')
sendPrompt('What hyperparameter tuning is done in the codebase, if any?')
sendPrompt('What pickle files does train_model.py save to disk after training?')
sendPrompt('How does the Streamlit app work? What are the three tabs?')
